public_declarations:
def sparseGBaseMeasure (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ) : Measure (ℝ × (ℕ × Bool)) :=
  Shao.OQ5.P35.noiseLaw.prod (sparseSignedLabelMeasure α x N)

def sparseG (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ) (z : ℝ × (ℕ × Bool)) : ℝ :=
  z.1 + sparseSignedShift α x N z.2

theorem sparseGBaseMeasure_probability :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ),
  IsProbabilityMeasure (sparseGBaseMeasure α x N)

theorem measurable_sparseG :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ), Measurable (sparseG α x N)

theorem integrable_sparseG :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ), 0 < α → SparseSelectionCore α x N →
  Integrable (sparseG α x N) (sparseGBaseMeasure α x N)

theorem integral_sparseG_zero :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ), 0 < α → SparseSelectionCore α x N →
  (∫ z, sparseG α x N z ∂(sparseGBaseMeasure α x N)) = 0

theorem integrable_sparseG_sq :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ), 0 < α → SparseSelectionCore α x N →
  Integrable (fun z => (sparseG α x N z) ^ 2) (sparseGBaseMeasure α x N)

theorem integral_sparseG_sq :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ), 0 < α → SparseSelectionCore α x N →
  (∫ z, (sparseG α x N z) ^ 2 ∂(sparseGBaseMeasure α x N)) =
    (1 / 3 : ℝ) + ∫ w, (sparseSignedShift α x N w) ^ 2 ∂(sparseSignedLabelMeasure α x N)

theorem integral_sparseG_sq_ge :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ), 0 < α → SparseSelectionCore α x N →
  (1 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ ∫ z, (sparseG α x N z) ^ 2 ∂(sparseGBaseMeasure α x N)

theorem integrable_sparseG_rpow :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ), 0 < α → SparseSelectionCore α x N → ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q →
  Integrable (fun z => |sparseG α x N z| ^ q) (sparseGBaseMeasure α x N)

head: bf63351ffb8d691e28db6f076380ea8999e13d4a
public_declarations:
theorem sparsePopulationMeasure_probability :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ),
  IsProbabilityMeasure (sparsePopulationMeasure α x N)

theorem sparsePopulationG_law :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ),
  (sparsePopulationMeasure α x N).map (sparsePopulationG α x N) =
    (sparseGBaseMeasure α x N).map (sparseG α x N)

theorem sparsePopulationZ_law :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ),
  (sparsePopulationMeasure α x N).map (sparsePopulationZ α x N) =
    (sparseSignedLabelMeasure α x N).map (sparseSignedAmplitude α x N)

theorem measurable_sparsePopulationG :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ), Measurable (sparsePopulationG α x N)

theorem measurable_sparsePopulationZ :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ), Measurable (sparsePopulationZ α x N)

theorem sparsePopulationG_indep_Z :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ),
  ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun (sparsePopulationG α x N) (sparsePopulationZ α x N)
    (sparsePopulationMeasure α x N)

theorem integrable_sparsePopulationG_rpow :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ), 0 < α → SparseSelectionCore α x N → ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q →
  Integrable (fun z => |sparsePopulationG α x N z| ^ q) (sparsePopulationMeasure α x N)

theorem integrable_sparsePopulationZ_rpow :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ), 0 < α → ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q →
  Integrable (fun z => |sparsePopulationZ α x N z| ^ q) (sparsePopulationMeasure α x N)

theorem integral_sparsePopulationG_zero :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ), 0 < α → SparseSelectionCore α x N →
  (∫ z, sparsePopulationG α x N z ∂(sparsePopulationMeasure α x N)) = 0

theorem integral_sparsePopulationZ_zero :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ), 0 < α →
  (∫ z, sparsePopulationZ α x N z ∂(sparsePopulationMeasure α x N)) = 0

theorem integral_sparsePopulationG_sq_ge :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ), 0 < α → SparseSelectionCore α x N →
  (1 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ ∫ z, (sparsePopulationG α x N z) ^ 2 ∂(sparsePopulationMeasure α x N)

theorem integral_sparsePopulationZ_sq_pos :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ), 0 < α → SparseSelectionCore α x N →
  0 < ∫ z, (sparsePopulationZ α x N z) ^ 2 ∂(sparsePopulationMeasure α x N)

theorem integrable_sparsePopulationZ_exp :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ), 0 < α → ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → τ ≤ 1 →
  Integrable (fun z => Real.exp (τ * |sparsePopulationZ α x N z| ^ α))
    (sparsePopulationMeasure α x N)

theorem integral_sparsePopulationZ_exp_le :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ), 0 < α → ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → τ ≤ 1 →
  (∫ z, Real.exp (τ * |sparsePopulationZ α x N z| ^ α) ∂(sparsePopulationMeasure α x N)) ≤ (5 / 4 : ℝ)

head: 0c31fe47a3b978b4e3fe20267bf020bd389b33db
public_declarations:
def sparsePopulationKernel (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ)
    (u v : ((ℝ × (ℕ × Bool)) × (ℕ × Bool))) : ℝ :=
  sparsePopulationG α x N u + sparsePopulationG α x N v +
    sparsePopulationZ α x N u * sparsePopulationZ α x N v

theorem measurable_sparsePopulationKernel :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ),
  Measurable (fun w : ((ℝ × (ℕ × Bool)) × (ℕ × Bool)) × ((ℝ × (ℕ × Bool)) × (ℕ × Bool)) => sparsePopulationKernel α x N w.1 w.2)

theorem sparsePopulationKernel_symmetric :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ), ∀ (u v : ((ℝ × (ℕ × Bool)) × (ℕ × Bool))),
  sparsePopulationKernel α x N u v = sparsePopulationKernel α x N v u

theorem integrable_sparsePopulationKernel :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ), 0 < α → SparseSelectionCore α x N →
  Integrable (fun w : ((ℝ × (ℕ × Bool)) × (ℕ × Bool)) × ((ℝ × (ℕ × Bool)) × (ℕ × Bool)) => sparsePopulationKernel α x N w.1 w.2)
    ((sparsePopulationMeasure α x N).prod (sparsePopulationMeasure α x N))

theorem integrable_sparsePopulationKernel_rpow :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ), 0 < α → SparseSelectionCore α x N → ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q →
  Integrable (fun w : ((ℝ × (ℕ × Bool)) × (ℕ × Bool)) × ((ℝ × (ℕ × Bool)) × (ℕ × Bool)) => |sparsePopulationKernel α x N w.1 w.2| ^ q)
    ((sparsePopulationMeasure α x N).prod (sparsePopulationMeasure α x N))

theorem integrable_sparsePopulationKernel_right :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ), 0 < α → SparseSelectionCore α x N → ∀ u : ((ℝ × (ℕ × Bool)) × (ℕ × Bool)),
  Integrable (sparsePopulationKernel α x N u) (sparsePopulationMeasure α x N)

theorem integral_sparsePopulationKernel_right :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ), 0 < α → SparseSelectionCore α x N → ∀ u : ((ℝ × (ℕ × Bool)) × (ℕ × Bool)),
  (∫ v, sparsePopulationKernel α x N u v ∂(sparsePopulationMeasure α x N)) = sparsePopulationG α x N u

theorem integral_sparsePopulationKernel_zero :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ), 0 < α → SparseSelectionCore α x N →
  (∫ w : ((ℝ × (ℕ × Bool)) × (ℕ × Bool)) × ((ℝ × (ℕ × Bool)) × (ℕ × Bool)), sparsePopulationKernel α x N w.1 w.2
    ∂((sparsePopulationMeasure α x N).prod (sparsePopulationMeasure α x N))) = 0

theorem sparsePopulationResidual_decomposition :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ), ∀ (u v : ((ℝ × (ℕ × Bool)) × (ℕ × Bool))),
  sparsePopulationKernel α x N u v - sparsePopulationG α x N u - sparsePopulationG α x N v =
    sparsePopulationResidual α x N u v

theorem integrable_sparsePopulationResidual_right :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ), 0 < α → ∀ u : ((ℝ × (ℕ × Bool)) × (ℕ × Bool)),
  Integrable (sparsePopulationResidual α x N u) (sparsePopulationMeasure α x N)

theorem integral_sparsePopulationResidual_right_zero :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ), 0 < α → ∀ u : ((ℝ × (ℕ × Bool)) × (ℕ × Bool)),
  (∫ v, sparsePopulationResidual α x N u v ∂(sparsePopulationMeasure α x N)) = 0

theorem integrable_sparsePopulationResidual_sq :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ), 0 < α →
  Integrable (fun w : ((ℝ × (ℕ × Bool)) × (ℕ × Bool)) × ((ℝ × (ℕ × Bool)) × (ℕ × Bool)) =>
      (sparsePopulationResidual α x N w.1 w.2) ^ 2)
    ((sparsePopulationMeasure α x N).prod (sparsePopulationMeasure α x N))

theorem integral_sparsePopulationResidual_sq :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ), 0 < α →
  (∫ w : ((ℝ × (ℕ × Bool)) × (ℕ × Bool)) × ((ℝ × (ℕ × Bool)) × (ℕ × Bool)), (sparsePopulationResidual α x N w.1 w.2) ^ 2
    ∂((sparsePopulationMeasure α x N).prod (sparsePopulationMeasure α x N))) =
    (∫ u, (sparsePopulationZ α x N u) ^ 2 ∂(sparsePopulationMeasure α x N)) ^ 2

theorem integral_sparsePopulationResidual_sq_pos :
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℕ), 0 < α → SparseSelectionCore α x N →
  0 < ∫ w : ((ℝ × (ℕ × Bool)) × (ℕ × Bool)) × ((ℝ × (ℕ × Bool)) × (ℕ × Bool)), (sparsePopulationResidual α x N w.1 w.2) ^ 2
    ∂((sparsePopulationMeasure α x N).prod (sparsePopulationMeasure α x N))
